At a glance

Colour change car wraps in Vaughan & Toronto

A colour-change wrap replaces the visible colour of your car with cast vinyl film — gloss, satin, matte, satin chrome or colour-flip — without repainting. It protects the factory paint underneath and comes off cleanly from OEM paint when you want the original colour back.

  • Full wraps from$2,800 for a car · $3,400 for an SUV (before tax)
  • How long it lastsGloss 5–7 years · matte and satin 3–5 years · chrome and colour-flip 2–3 years on horizontal surfaces
  • CareHand wash or touchless car wash; avoid brush washes

Why colour change

Every finish paint can’t do, and a few it can.

A colour-change wrap replaces the visible colour of the vehicle with cast vinyl film — gloss, satin, matte, satin chrome or colour-flip — without touching the paint underneath. It protects the factory finish, holds resale value, and comes off cleanly when you want the original colour back.

We disassemble handles, lights and trim where needed so the film tucks behind edges rather than being cut on the panel, and we template panel gaps and camera cut-outs on modern vehicles so the finish looks factory.

150+ colours

The full 3M 2080 and Avery SW900 ranges, sampled in-shop.

Protects the paint

Stone chips and swirls land on the film, not the clear coat.

Fully reversible

Removes cleanly from OEM paint, even years later.

Door jambs optional

Add jambs for a colour match when the doors are open.

Before you book

What to know about a colour change.

Paint conditionMust be OEM or a fully cured, professionally applied repaint. Peeling clear coat can’t be wrapped.
Finish careMatte and satin: no wax, no polish, no automatic brush washes. Gloss: treat like paint.
Lead timeFilm ordered to colour — allow 3–5 days for material plus 2–3 days in the bay
Warranty5-year workmanship; film warranty per manufacturer (3–7 years by finish)
RegistrationOntario doesn’t require you to update the colour on your ownership, but your insurer may want to know
  1. Consult & measureWe confirm the vehicle, year and trim, then measure or template every panel we’ll cover.
  2. Design & proofYour artwork goes onto a to-scale vehicle template. You approve a proof before print.
  3. Print & laminatePrinted in-house on cast wrap film and sealed under a matching laminate for UV and abrasion.
  4. Prep & installThe vehicle is decontaminated, then wrapped panel by panel in a climate-controlled bay.
  5. Post-heat & inspectEdges and recesses are post-heated to lock the film, then the whole vehicle is inspected.
Book a 20-minute sample session — we keep swatch books of every finish so you can see it on the actual vehicle in daylight.

FAQ

Questions we get asked most.

Still unsure? Send us a note and we’ll answer within one business day.

All FAQsContact us
Does a colour-change wrap hurt resale value?
The opposite, usually — the film has been protecting the original paint, and it comes off cleanly on OEM finishes. Many owners remove it before sale to reveal a like-new finish.
How long does the colour last?
Gloss films run 5–7 years; matte and satin 3–5 years; chrome and colour-flip 2–3 years on horizontal surfaces. All of them longer if the vehicle is garaged.
Can you match a specific paint colour?
We can get close with the standard ranges, and printed colour-change film lets us hit an exact swatch when a close match isn’t enough.
Are door jambs included?
Not by default. Most customers skip them; if you want a full match with the doors open, add jambs and we’ll quote the extra labour.
Can I take it through a car wash?
Touchless washes are fine. Brush washes will eventually scuff the film, especially matte and satin — hand washing is best.
